GB.name: Met Office SYNOP observations distributed by DWD
GB.period: National SYNOP precipitation: reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with UTC observation times. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form longer totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Reporting frequency varies by station.

PL.name: IMGW-PIB SYNOP observations distributed by DWD
PL.period: National SYNOP precipitation: reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with UTC observation times. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form longer totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Reporting frequency varies by station.

DE.name: Deutscher Wetterdienst / official SYNOP gauges
DE.period: National SYNOP precipitation: reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with UTC observation times. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form longer totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Reporting frequency varies by station.

SK.name: SHMÚ SYNOP observations distributed by DWD
SK.period: National SYNOP precipitation: reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with UTC observation times. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form longer totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Reporting frequency varies by station.

LU.name: MeteoLux / Luxembourg-Findel SYNOP observations distributed by DWD
LU.period: Luxembourg-Findel SYNOP gauge. Currently reports 6- and 12-hour precipitation; 24 and 48 hours require complete adjacent intervals. No hourly total is inferred from these longer reports.

IE.name: Met Éireann / official hourly rain gauges
IE.period: Met Éireann total hourly rainfall in mm, excluding event-driven tips. Complete measured hours are required for longer totals.

NL.name: KNMI / hourly precipitation and official SYNOP gauges
NL.period: KNMI RH hourly archive in 0.1 mm, converted to mm, supplemented with current KNMI SYNOP precipitation distributed by DWD. Identical station IDs are merged. Hour 24 ends at midnight UTC; traces below 0.05 mm are flagged. Native longer intervals are retained without inventing hourly totals.

BE.name: Royal Meteorological Institute / RMI-KMI gauges
BE.period: RMI/KMI precipitation in mm for each ten-minute interval. All six samples are required for a completed clock hour; near-real-time observations are provisional.

CZ.name: Czech Hydrometeorological Institute / ČHMÚ
CZ.period: ČHMÚ SRA1H hourly precipitation in mm with UTC observation times. Quality 0 and provisional 5 accepted; suspect, estimated and missing observations excluded.

FR.name: Météo-France / official SYNOP precipitation, distributed by DWD
FR.period: Official Météo-France SYNOP precipitation in mm. Native 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour reports retain their UTC observation times. The official annual SYNOP archive bootstraps history; DWD supplies current reports. Only complete non-overlapping intervals form 24/48-hour totals. Coverage is the reporting SYNOP subset, not the full national gauge network.

AD.name: Servei Meteorològic Nacional / Meteo.ad
AD.period: Source: Servei Meteorològic Nacional / Meteo.ad. Hourly precipitation chart values retain their native UTC hour labels; the current chart hour is excluded. Climatological daily precipitation runs from 06:00 UTC on the labelled day to 06:00 UTC the next day. Two complete adjacent days can form a 48-hour total ending at 06:00 UTC; it is not a current rolling total. Missing hours stay unavailable; provisional.

ES.name: AEMET / Agencia Estatal de Meteorología
ES.period: AEMET hourly precipitation in mm (native UTC interval ends), including the Balearic and Canary Islands. Calendar-day precipitation covers 00:00–24:00 UTC; the daily layer date is the labelled calendar day, not its map-generation offset. Daily reports can form complete 24/48-hour totals ending at midnight; actual ends are shown. Missing hours stay unavailable; provisional.

AT.name: GeoSphere Austria / TAWES rain gauges
AT.period: GeoSphere Austria TAWES ten-minute precipitation (RR), in mm and UTC. Every one of the six ten-minute samples is required for an hourly total. Complete consecutive hourly measurements form 24/48-hour totals; missing intervals stay unavailable. Operational raw measurements are provisional. CC BY 4.0.

CH.name: Source: MeteoSwiss / SwissMetNet and automatic precipitation stations
CH.period: Source: MeteoSwiss. Provider-aggregated hourly precipitation (rre150h0), in mm and UTC, from SwissMetNet and automatic precipitation stations. The recent archive backfills the initial history; current hourly files update the shared cache. Complete consecutive hours are required for 24/48-hour totals. Missing values stay unavailable; operational data are provisional.

IT.name: Official Italian SYNOP rain gauges / Servizio Meteorologico dell’Aeronautica Militare via DWD
IT.period: Official SYNOP measured precipitation in mm, with native UTC observation times. Reported 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals are retained. Only complete, non-overlapping intervals form 24/48-hour totals. Some stations report only every three or six hours; actual ending times are shown. Missing hourly values are never inferred from longer totals. Coverage is the reporting SYNOP subset, not every national rain gauge.

HR.name: DHMZ / official Croatian SYNOP and daily rain gauges
HR.period: Official measured precipitation in mm. Native 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour SYNOP reporting periods retain their UTC ending times. Only complete adjacent measurements from the same gauge form 24/48h totals. A 1h reading appears only when explicitly reported; longer totals are never divided into hourly estimates. Missing, blank, trace-only and lower-bound values stay unavailable as numeric amounts. Older complete totals show their actual ending time. DHMZ daily reports cover 06 UTC yesterday to 06 UTC today; the public daily list includes wet gauges only. Omitted gauges are not assumed dry. Izvor: DHMZ; Otvorena dozvola Republike Hrvatske.

SI.name: Vir: Agencija Republike Slovenije za okolje (ARSO) / automatic rain gauges
SI.period: Vir: Agencija Republike Slovenije za okolje (ARSO). Automatic, provisional gauge precipitation in mm. Official one-hour accumulations are used at completed UTC clock hours; otherwise all six measured ten-minute intervals are required. Native 24-hour reports are retained at their actual ending times. Only complete adjacent intervals form 24/48-hour totals; missing, suspect and future readings stay unavailable. History is fetched centrally, not per visitor.

TR.name: Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü (MGM) / official Turkish rain gauges
TR.period: MGM provisional measured precipitation in mm. Rolling 1-hour and 24-hour totals retain their actual UTC ending minute. Daily totals end at 06:00 UTC; 48-hour totals require two consecutive complete daily reports from the same gauge. A 24-hour daily total supplements stations without a rolling report. Missing reports remain unavailable; midnight-to-now counters are not used. Daily and rolling windows may have different ending times.

UA.name: Ukrainian Hydrometeorological Center / WIS2 automatic gauges with official SYNOP backup
UA.period: UHMC WIS2 provisional measured precipitation/water equivalent: explicit 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour intervals, with native UTC start and end times. kg m-2 equals mm. Only adjacent complete intervals from the same WIGOS station form 24/48h totals. Official SYNOP observations supplement coverage. Missing, future, unknown-station and wrong-unit reports are excluded; no interval is divided into invented hourly rain.

RO.name: Administrația Națională de Meteorologie (ANM) / official SYNOP via NOAA and DWD
RO.period: Official national SYNOP precipitation in mm, with actual UTC observation times. Explicit one-hour reports are used for 1h; longer reports are never divided into invented hours. Complete, non-overlapping measured intervals form 24/48h totals. The shared 72-hour history builds automatically; incomplete windows remain unavailable. Delayed totals retain their actual ending times.

HU.name: HungaroMet / official hourly automatic rain gauges and 06–06 UTC daily totals
HU.period: HungaroMet provisional hourly precipitation r in mm, at native UTC clock hours. Daily rau covers 06 UTC on the stated date to 06 UTC the following day. Only complete adjacent intervals from the same station form 24/48h totals. Daily-based totals retain their actual 06 UTC ending time; missing/sentinel values stay unavailable. Source quality columns are reserved for development, not quality-approved flags.

BA.name: FHMZ / official Bosnia and Herzegovina automatic and SYNOP rain gauges
BA.period: Official measured precipitation in mm. Native 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour SYNOP reporting periods retain their UTC ending times. Only complete adjacent measurements from the same gauge form 24/48h totals. A 1h reading appears only when explicitly reported; longer totals are never divided into hourly estimates. Missing, blank, trace-only and lower-bound values stay unavailable as numeric amounts. Older complete totals show their actual ending time. FHMZ automatic gauges additionally provide explicit hourly precipitation and rolling 24-hour totals, with dated chart history. Local Europe/Sarajevo times are converted to UTC; ambiguous DST hours are excluded.

ME.name: ZHMS Montenegro / official SYNOP rain gauges
ME.period: Official measured precipitation in mm. Native 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour SYNOP reporting periods retain their UTC ending times. Only complete adjacent measurements from the same gauge form 24/48h totals. A 1h reading appears only when explicitly reported; longer totals are never divided into hourly estimates. Missing, blank, trace-only and lower-bound values stay unavailable as numeric amounts. Older complete totals show their actual ending time.

XK.name: Official Kosovo SYNOP gauge reports via DWD (limited reporting subset)
XK.error: No recent official XK rain reports
XK.period: Official measured precipitation in mm. Native 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour SYNOP reporting periods retain their UTC ending times. Only complete adjacent measurements from the same gauge form 24/48h totals. A 1h reading appears only when explicitly reported; longer totals are never divided into hourly estimates. Missing, blank, trace-only and lower-bound values stay unavailable as numeric amounts. Older complete totals show their actual ending time. No current gauge rainfall is available in the connected Kosovo feed. Where nearby foreign official gauges support it, the map shows a terrain-weighted estimate within 100 km; that shading is not a Kosovo station measurement.

GR.name: Hellenic National Meteorological Service (HNMS) / official Greek SYNOP rain gauges
GR.period: Official measured precipitation in mm. Native 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour SYNOP reporting periods retain their UTC ending times. Only complete adjacent measurements from the same gauge form 24/48h totals. A 1h reading appears only when explicitly reported; longer totals are never divided into hourly estimates. Missing, blank, trace-only and lower-bound values stay unavailable as numeric amounts. Older complete totals show their actual ending time. Mainland and island stations; land SYNOP reports may be three- or six-hourly. The shared updater retains 72 hours of measured history. Missing hourly values are never estimated from longer reports.

RS.name: Republic Hydrometeorological Service of Serbia (RHMZ) / official SYNOP and daily gauge measurements
RS.period: Official measured precipitation in mm. Native 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour SYNOP reporting periods retain their UTC ending times. Only complete adjacent measurements from the same gauge form 24/48h totals. A 1h reading appears only when explicitly reported; longer totals are never divided into hourly estimates. Missing, blank, trace-only and lower-bound values stay unavailable as numeric amounts. Older complete totals show their actual ending time. RHMZ dated daily reports cover 06 UTC yesterday to 06 UTC today; blank cells are not treated as zero.

BG.name: National Institute of Meteorology and Hydrology (NIMH), Bulgaria / official SYNOP gauges
BG.period: Official measured precipitation in mm. Native 1-, 3-, 6-, 12- and 24-hour SYNOP reporting periods retain their UTC ending times. Only complete adjacent measurements from the same gauge form 24/48h totals. A 1h reading appears only when explicitly reported; longer totals are never divided into hourly estimates. Missing, blank, trace-only and lower-bound values stay unavailable as numeric amounts. Older complete totals show their actual ending time.
